source.source_title: UIUC Propeller Database Volume 4, APC 12x6 Thin Electric static data
source.method: Independent wind-tunnel static characterization; Ct and Cp are dimensionless measured coefficients.

comparison.boundary: This is a characterization regression test, not an airworthiness or product-certification finding. APC source tables are analytical and the UIUC values are wind-tunnel measurements.
